root_cause: Confirmed at the selected historical commit by local regression tests and a fresh ABB before/after run. slice_read_response uses str.splitlines(keepends=True), which recognizes form feed and other Unicode line separators. grep_matches_from_files and the displayed gutter count LF boundaries. Therefore grep reports SECRET_TARGET at line 6 while read_file(offset=5, limit=1) returns def beta(). The local patch splits only universal newline sequences (LF, CRLF, CR), preserving terminators and EOF state. With the same file bytes, the patched native tool returns SECRET_TARGET at line 6. This is a locally validated repair, not an upstream merged fix.
